bio_draft: DJ MoCity was born in Baghdad and raised in New Delhi, and co-founded the online community radio station boxout.fm with Dualist Inquiry, where he hosts the show Motellacast. He also co-founded Reggae Rajahs, described as India's first reggae sound system, and the labels Dualism Records and 264 Records.
notes: Wikipedia lists the website as djmocity.com while RA lists mohd.website; I used the RA one. Wikipedia gives two different boxout.fm launch dates (May 2016 and April 2017). He lived in Dubai from 2014 (Wild City 2014 calls Dubai his home then) and returned to India in 2016 per Wikipedia. based_city New Delhi is from his own Bandcamp fan profile. Mixcloud blog interview on his Mixcloud Online Radio Awards win (mixcloud.com/blog/2018/04/25/...) was blocked by a permission timeout, not used. No solo releases listed anywhere I opened.

bio_draft: EZZYLAND is the project of producer and rapper Sidharth Ezhilan, born in Salem, Tamil Nadu, who has lived in Dubai, Hyderabad and Chennai. He makes sample-built beats that mix electronic music with hip hop, and hosts ZZY on boxout.fm, a show that pairs alternative, ambient, trip-hop and trap finds with better-known tracks.
notes: Based in Chennai in 2014 (Rolling Stone India); current base not stated, so based_city left null. RSJ Online names The Simple EP (with single After Dark) and Alien Brown (track Shoegazing), self-released on SoundCloud, but gives no years, so not added as releases. bio_draft: Fadescha is a DJ, artist and curator from New Delhi, working between Berlin and New Delhi, and a member of the Delhi collective Coven Code. Their DJ sets cover techno and house leaning towards acid, industrial and psychedelic sounds, and they host Party Office, an art and social space in New Delhi.
notes: Hyperallergic (2023) describes Fadescha as nonbinary; the 2019 pages use she/her. Bio draft uses they/their; Param may want to confirm current pronouns. Hyperallergic says they live and work between Berlin and New Delhi. Also co-founded Sive (collective on caste and gender) and the After Party Collective AV act per FEMWAV/WHR. Real first name appears on pages; not used. No releases confirmed.

bio_draft: Farhan Rehman is a Mumbai DJ and producer who started producing at 16 and landed his first record on Ovum Recordings. He is the A&R and label manager of Dynamite Disco Club, the Indian disco and house label, and his sets and productions draw on afro, funk, jazz, house and disco.
notes: Disco Segway year is from the Mixmag Asia article dated 9 Aug 2021 calling it the label's second release; exact date not shown. Not a l.u.v thang is called his latest single in Mixmag Asia (Nov 2024); label not stated, year 2024 is the article year. Strictly Rhythm is on the compilation Dynamite Cuts Vol. 1 (DDC's 50th release); Electronic Groove gives both 11 July and 18 July 2025, so date left null. His first Ovum Recordings record is not named on any page opened. Beats Beyond Borders links Beatport and Traxsource discographies, not opened, so no ids. Wild City EP article calls it two tracks; Bandcamp lists four (two originals plus radio edits).
